name: revyl
description: Sign in to Revyl from Capy and run, preview, and verify mobile app changes on Revyl cloud iOS and Android devices from Capy cloud threads.

REVYL_API_KEY.description: Optional. Your personal Revyl API key, from Settings → API Keys in the Revyl dashboard. With it, dev loops start without a sign-in; without it, the agent posts a Revyl approval link the first time a thread needs the dev loop.
